account_id.description: The account with the retained-earnings role.

end.description: start + posted + the year's result: its balance on the next year's first day, which the balance service works out whenever it reads one.

posted.description: What was posted to it in the year, such as the opening balances at the books start.

start.description: Its balance on the year's first day: every earlier year's result and what was posted to it before. A credit, so negative, is accumulated profit.
